judgments.printed_text: 14.1 Intermediaries should carry out a review annually to ensure that the SPI continues to fulfil the requisite requirements set out in section (A) above and continues to agree for the intermediary to execute investment transactions falling within the Product Categories and the Streamlining Threshold specified by the SPI under a Streamlined Approach.
judgments.explanation: The printed page clearly shows “14.1” immediately before “Intermediaries should carry out a review annually”. The listed deletion removes this visible paragraph identifier; it is an omission of text, not a typographic difference. This finding concerns the printed text and does not determine legal applicability.
judgments.affected_condition: The paragraph identifier 14.1 for the annual review provision.
